notes.title: Full controller support is here!
notes.notes: [p]Now you can play the game and navigate the menu using only the controller![/p][p][/p][p]Also, I've fixed a couple of bugs:[/p][list][*][p]Red tint remaining after game restart[/p][/*][*][p]Missing vacuum cleaner shadow[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Check the demo, and add Robot Anomaly to your wishlist![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3583330/Robot_Anomaly/?curator_clanid=4777282"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Updates recap!
notes.notes:
Hi! Here is a summary of improvements made to the game and the demo:

[list]
[*] When recording the game on Steam the timeline will display additional information about the game.
[*] Also your status will change depending of your current stage in the game (Rich presence).
[*] Now the game will automatically select the best language for you on the first start. And you can change it in the new "Audio and Language" settings menu!
[*] Added interactivity to the tutorial to help players learn how to turn robots off, and how to remove their brains.
[*] Added a separate savefile for stats (time played).
[*] Thanks to a contributor (fix-sta) Robot Anomaly now has German language!
[*] I've improved the settings for Anti Aliasing and scaling. To ensure everyone can play without issues I've also added a Quality setting with 4 quality levels
[*] Bugfixes!
[*] Made several changes to minimize freezes when loading a new floor. Let me know how it goes for you!
[/list]

Play the demo! and remember to leave a review, that helps me improve the game! ːsteamthumbsupː

Thanks! 

Eibriel
